summary_rationale: Bloom has a differentiated, commercially deployed solid-oxide onsite-power platform, named repeat customers, a growing service base, and materially stronger recent product growth and gross margins. Business quality remains conditional on converting large project commitments into financed, permitted, accepted installations and then into durable service economics. Customer concentration, long project cycles, installation and warranty obligations, volatile working capital, factory investment, and reliance on external financing make the improvement less proven through a full cycle. Positive 2026 operating results and cash flow are encouraging, but a sustained record of cash generation after factory investment and working-capital needs is not yet established.
